strings.localization.title: Localization
strings.localization.summary: Source strings and their projected locations for this exact build.
strings.localization.searchPlaceholder: Find a source string, value, screen or element
strings.localization.unmapped: Not mapped by this Screen Lens.
strings.localization.noMatches: No source strings match this search.
strings.localization.noSelection: Search a source string, or select a Product element to see its text binding.
strings.localization.previewLocaleHelp: Read-only Lens preview. It reprojects Product-authored localized bindings here; it does not change Product language or saved settings.
strings.localization.localeMissingDetail: No value for this locale is observed in Product source. VexBoard leaves the Product projection unchanged rather than inventing fallback behavior.
strings.localization.changeSetHelp: Private to this browser. It records what you expect to become true; it does not change Product source.
strings.localization.expectedValuePlaceholder: Enter the value you want this locale to use
strings.localization.noDraft: No expected value is saved for this string and locale.
strings.localization.importedChangeSet: Imported and reconciled against current source.
strings.localization.workingSetEmpty: No changes are saved for this Product revision yet.
strings.localization.stateSourceRemoved: Source string is no longer present
strings.localization.storageUnavailable: Browser-local Change Sets are unavailable because saved data could not be read safely.
strings.localization.notConnectedTitle: Localization isn't connected to this Lens build yet.
strings.localization.notConnectedDetail: Localization is part of the shared VexBoard frame for every project. Once this Product exposes its localization source through an adapter, strings, locales, locations, and Change Sets appear here.
strings.localization.loadErrorTitle: Localization couldn't load for this Lens build.
strings.localization.loadErrorDetail: The rest of Screen Lens is still available. The localization source or sidecar needs to be repaired before its strings can be inspected here.
strings.localization.addLanguagePlaceholder: Locale code, e.g. it or nl-NL
strings.localization.addLanguageHelp: Adds a browser-local translation target. Product support is not claimed until that locale appears in Product source.
